title: Little Artist!

intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi mastered days, dates and seasons. 📅
Today is rainy outside — perfect for an ART DAY at home!

scenes.title: The Dinosaur Drawing
scenes.caption:
Rawr! A T-Rex appears on Kimi's paper.
Well... sort of.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Look at this dinosaur I drew! Isn't this cool? 🦕

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Wow, it looks so real!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, can you draw a car for me?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: You can draw it by yourself. Try drawing the wheels by yourself.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Look, Mom! Here's my circle! ⭕

scenes.title: Color Inside the Lines
scenes.caption:
Yellow sun, blue sky, pink flowers...
Stay inside the lines, Kimi!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Now let's color the sketch. Get out the crayons.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I'm going to paint this part yellow! ...Oh no, the crayon is broken! 🖍️

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Try to color inside the line. Don't leave any blank part.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: What color do you want to paint the flower?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Pink, of course! 🌸

scenes.title: The Sticker Book
scenes.caption:
Sparkly stars, shiny apples...
But think BEFORE you stick!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I want to play with some stickers! ⭐

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Take off the stickers first. Where are you going to put it on?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, the sticker won't come off! I accidentally tore it. 😢

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's hard to get it off if you put it in the wrong place.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Look! It looks cool with stickers!

scenes.title: The Origami Frog
scenes.caption:
Fold, fold, fold... a flat paper square
becomes a hopping frog!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's do origami. It's important to follow the directions.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Fold it in half... fold it diagonally... I've got a triangle! 📐

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let the corners meet exactly. The dotted lines mean to fold it.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Want to fold a frog? Ribbit, ribbit! 🐸

scenes.title: The Clay Person
scenes.caption:
Roll it, press it, stick the eyes on...
who is this little clay person?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's play with clay. Put a lump between your palms and roll it.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I'm going to make a person! ...Oh no, the legs keep coming off! 😂

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Press it firmly with your hands. Make the eyes, nose and mouth, and attach them on the face.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Ta-da! It's YOU, Mom! 🗿

songs: 👐 Roll the clay between your palms

ending.title: Gallery Opening: Kimi's Room!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: Playdate & Wheels! ⚽
